title: Setback to an adjoining laneway or right-of-way that is not the primary street
text: C3.3.1 Buildings are set back from the street boundary in accordance with Table 3.3a. Table 3.3a Minimum setback of buildings from the street, adjoining laneway or right-of-way, where it is not the primary street to the dwelling: R2, R2.5, R5, R10 and R12.5 as per Secondary Street setbacks; R15-25, R30-35, R40 and R50-80 0.5m.

replaces.note: ROW or communal street treated as secondary street (1.5 m R15-R25) -> 0.5 m
ROW not primary 0.5 m; communal street row (0.5 m) no longer listed (register ch3-047)

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: R2-R12.5 take the secondary street value; R15+ 0.5 m (register ch3-046 and Table 3A, p7, give the same column split). Communal streets are not listed (C3.3.1#communal-street).

verified.note: Merged cells confirmed: 'As per Secondary Street setbacks' is one cell spanning R2 to R12.5; 0.5m spans R15-25 to R50-80 (p30; Table 3A p7 agrees).
